name: scan-consent-via-permission
body: The distributed `codebase-navigator` prompt carries no bespoke scan-consent ritual. Scan authorization is delegated to opencode's per-call tool permission: the navigator's `permissions` array carries an `apg_scan` rule with effect `ask`, so opencode prompts the user on each call and the user's "always allow" choice suppresses future prompts. The prompt carries no "ask the user first" / "get explicit approval before starting one" / "ask the user before running a scan" / "(after user approval)" scan wording and no `question`-tool scan-consent step. When the graph is missing or stale, the agent runs `apg_scan` rather than guessing, and never re-runs a scan silently. Prose; assessed by review.
